game: The Keeper's Hour 0.3.1 (HarperZ9/brender-archival release keepers-v0.3.1, keepers-hour-0.3.1-windows-x64.zip)
recorder: KEEPERS_RECORD (games/keepers-hour/src/kh_capture.h): frame n shows game time KEEPERS_CLOCK + n / KEEPERS_FPS exactly, so two runs give the same bytes
renderer: --force-software: BRender's software rasteriser on the CPU (the storyboard's OpenGL path would draw on the GPU, which this draft does not use)
note: KEEPERS_CLOCK is the trailer time at the shot's first frame, so the lamp keeps one phase across every cut.
camera_note: The recorder's camera orbits above each room, so the storyboard's low angle on the tower, the dry seabed and the town far off are not in view; the yaw of each gallery shot was chosen from four test stills (60, 120, 210, 300 degrees) as the one with the most of the tower in frame.
ui_note: KEEPERS_OPEN=logbook opens the node's first line; reaching its [TIDE 8] check needs a choice the recorder cannot make, so sweep 10 shows the game's dialogue box on the logbook's opening line instead of the check (pending: a scripted choice in the recorder, owned by the brender-archival session).
